purpose: Canonical issuer-grounded catalog for federal training/resources referenced by Equity Uprise, with competency/building/scenario/lab bindings and explicit readiness/truth boundaries.
authority_rules: Official issuer pages control title, code, delivery, award and active-status claims.
A credential or course completion is external evidence; it is never identical to Equity Uprise competency mastery.
Reference standards, manuals, vulnerability datasets and advisories are not course completions.
Generic agency references are retained only when an exact stable course is not appropriate or the issuer catalog is intentionally dynamic.
B1 and OT learner activity is sandboxed-clone-only; no catalog record grants live control.
Learner-facing copy says 'prepares you for' and links the issuer; it never says certified or that a credential is earned on Equity Uprise.
Retired courses (retired_do_not_cite) are never bound or recommended.

usable_now: FEMA Independent Study courses listed here
HHS/OHRP Human Research Protection Foundational Training and Participant-Centered Informed Consent Training
CISA ICS 300 and ICS 401 virtual courses with associated hands-on labs
DOE FEMP training catalog (course availability is dynamic during current catalog updates)
EPA ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager online training resources
NOAA Digital Coast Academy on-demand resources
NASA ARSET current/self-paced offerings, with certificate rules varying by delivery
ATSDR Public Health Assessment Training curriculum
CISA ICS 100W and 210W web-based modules (the entry point before ICS 401/300)
real_lab_or_eligibility_later: CISA ICS 301 in-person Red Team/Blue Team lab after ICS 300 and current enrollment availability
CDC EHTER Operations 40-hour in-person course for eligible responders
DOE/FEMP re-tuning or live-facility work using real BAS/metering after site authorization
Any physical cabling, RF survey, live BAS/OT, life-safety, electrical or commissioning exercise
remediation_gaps: Classroom ICS-300/400 (G0300/G0400), CERT Basic and K/L0146 HSEEP are delivered by states/local government and are not cataloged as online courses.
Do not convert OSHA, FHWA, NIST, NVD or CISA KEV references into credentials.
Pin individual DOE/FEMP course IDs only after each course remains available through the current phased catalog refresh.
Re-confirm hours/CEU for IS-230.E, IS-240.C, IS-241.C, IS-242.C and IS-244.B on each course page.
Refresh IRS records for each tax year before a new VITA cohort begins.
Treat NOAA Digital Coast and NASA ARSET as dynamic training programs; bind individual offerings when selected for a cohort.
refresh_required: IRS VITA/TCE records are pinned to tax year 2025: refresh for the next filing season before any cohort (due 2026-11-30).
